configuration-properties.doc:name: Configuration Properties
configuration-properties.doc:description: Loads project parameters from config.yaml for listeners, TLS, and APIkit.

http:listener-config.name: api-httpListenerConfig
http:listener-config.doc:description: Defines the configured HTTPS listener used by the API and console flows.

http:listener-connection.doc:description: Binds the configured host and port with HTTPS and TLS_Context.

apikit:config.name: api-config
apikit:config.doc:description: Loads the configured Simplified Check-In PAPI OAS spec for routing and validation.

tls:context.name: TLS_Context
tls:context.doc:name: TLS Context
tls:context.doc:description: Provides the server key store used by the HTTPS listener.

tls:key-store.doc:description: Loads the configured PKCS#12 server certificate and key.

error-handler.name: api-global-error-handler
error-handler.doc:description: Centralizes APIkit error responses reused by the main API listener flow.

on-error-propagate.doc:description: Handles APIKIT:BAD_REQUEST by returning a JSON message and HTTP 400.

ee:transform.doc:name: Transform Message
ee:transform.doc:description: Builds the JSON error body and httpStatus variable for bad requests.

ee:message.doc:description: Defines the JSON payload for bad request errors.

ee:set-payload.doc:description: Sets a JSON body with a Bad request message.

ee:variables.doc:description: Sets the HTTP status variable for the bad request response.

ee:set-variable.doc:description: Sets httpStatus to 400 for bad request errors.
